title: Partial projected ensembles reveal slow tilt-constrained information spreading
summary: Projected ensembles reveal information about quantum many-body dynamics beyond the reduced density matrix. Here we investigate how spatial constraints affect the emergence of this information in a kicked Ising chain with a spatially varying longitudinal field. We consider partial projected ensembles, obtained by measuring a remote region while leaving an intervening buffer unobserved.
